guardrails.name: HR to Finance Database Isolation
guardrails.description: The HR subnet must NEVER have direct access to the Finance Core Database.
guardrails.rationale: Violates Segregation of Duties (SoD) under SOC2, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS standards. HR applications should only interface with financial systems through vetted, authenticated microservices, never direct raw database connections.

guardrails.name: Block Untrusted Direct Access to Management Jumpbox
guardrails.description: Non-IT departments are barred from administrative bastion jumpboxes.
guardrails.rationale: Prevents lateral movement and privilege escalation by non-administrative corporate users.
